boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on the North High Street corridor beside Ohio State, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Gateway Film Center
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor, Gateway University District
cards.notes: Check the current schedule, then choose a screening format or program that fits your visit. Tickets are sold online and at the Ticket Center.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent independent film venue with a published screening schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Gateway Film Center is at 1550 North High Street in the Gateway University District and publishes screenings and ticket information.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit – Gateway Film Center
cards.access_notes: Located at 1550 North High Street; Ticket Center hours are tied to scheduled showtimes.

cards.title: Ohio Union
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor at 1739 N High St
cards.notes: Use the public building as a practical stop for its meeting spaces, dining options, bookstore, Wi-Fi, and nearby garage.
cards.short_summary: A large student-union building with dining, a bookstore, and event spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ohio Union at 1739 N High St has 34 meeting spaces, dining locations, an Ohio State Bookstore, nearby parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi.
cards.source_title: Ohio Union | The Ohio State University
cards.access_notes: Address: 1739 N High St. Individual dining and event access can vary.

cards.title: Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor at Sullivant Hall
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit around the permanent comics exhibition, then allow time to look closely at original cartoon and comic art.
cards.short_summary: Free public galleries focused on comics and cartoon art.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s galleries are free and open to the public; its permanent Story of Comics exhibition is open Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: The Story of Comics | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The exhibition page lists 1–5 p.m., Tuesday–Sunday; the museum is closed Mondays.

cards.title: Fine Arts Library
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor, Wexner Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Bring a research question or art-book curiosity and use the public computers, scanners, or print services during posted library hours.
cards.short_summary: A small public-facing arts library with specialized equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Fine Arts Library offers public computers, printer/copier services, and scanners at 1871 North High Street.
cards.source_title: Fine Arts Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in 040L, Wexner Center for the Arts; its page lists weekday 10 a.m.–2 p.m. hours.

cards.title: Wexner Center for the Arts
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor at 1871 N High St
cards.notes: Look for current visual-arts, film, performance, or public-program listings before going, and use the High Street entrance address for navigation.
cards.short_summary: Ohio State’s contemporary-arts center on the High Street edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State describes the Wexner Center as a campus arts destination for performing arts, films, exhibitions, and concerts; its address is 1871 North High Street.
cards.source_title: Live in Columbus | The Ohio State University
cards.access_notes: The Wexner Center’s published address is 1871 North High Street; check its current program calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Ohio State Bookstore
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor inside the Ohio Union
cards.notes: Stop in for university-branded books and merchandise while using the Ohio Union’s High Street address as your arrival point.
cards.short_summary: The campus bookstore located within the Ohio Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State lists an Ohio State Bookstore among the amenities at the Ohio Union, 1739 N High St.
cards.source_title: Ohio Union | The Ohio State University
cards.access_notes: Inside the Ohio Union at 1739 N High St; verify bookstore hours directly before visiting.

cards.title: Newport Music Hall
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor north of campus
cards.notes: Review the venue’s current calendar, age policy, and ticket terms before making this a concert stop; choose an all-ages event when available.
cards.short_summary: A historic North High Street concert venue with a live event calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: PromoWest Live identifies Newport Music Hall as a Columbus venue and publishes its event listings and ticket links.
cards.access_notes: Event availability and age restrictions are event-specific; confirm them on the venue listing before purchase.

cards.title: Target Columbus High Street
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor at 1890 N High St
cards.notes: Use the store page to confirm services and stock before walking over for household basics, school supplies, or pickup availability.
cards.short_summary: A named High Street retail stop for practical essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: Target’s Columbus High Street store listing identifies the location at 1890 N High St in Columbus.
cards.access_notes: Address: 1890 N High St. Check the store page for current services and hours.

cards.title: Kafe Kerouac
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor in Old North Columbus
cards.notes: Check the café’s current events before heading north on High Street, especially if you want a reading, music, or community-program stop.
cards.short_summary: A named High Street café that publishes its own events and location details.
cards.evidence_claim: Kafe Kerouac’s official site provides its Columbus location and a calendar of events.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current calendar, hours, and any event-specific age policy on the official site.

cards.title: Jack & Benny's
cards.subtitle: North High Street corridor north of campus
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s own menu and location information to plan a straightforward meal stop along High Street before continuing north.
cards.short_summary: A named North High Street restaurant with an official menu and location page.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack & Benny’s official website provides restaurant menu and location information for its Columbus operation.
cards.access_notes: Check the restaurant’s official site for current hours, service details, and availability.
